rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a communicative body or hand gesture.

example.english: You gesture for me to come over.
example.jyutping: nei5 daa2 go3 sau2 sai3 giu3 ngo5 gwo3 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for a general body movement when it is not specifically a hand signal or communicative gesture.

example.english: You need to do this gesture slowly.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dung6 zok3 jiu3 maan6 maan6 zou6

rows.note: Use this for an intentional act that shows an attitude or serves as a symbolic formality.

example.english: Sending flowers to the teacher was a very thoughtful gesture.
example.traditional: 佢送花畀老師，呢個舉動好有心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sung3 faa1 bei2 lou5 si1 ni1 go3 geoi2 dung6 hou2 jau5 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the gesture is chiefly a token of goodwill, sympathy, or caring rather than the physical act itself.

example.english: The gift isn't expensive; the gesture is what matters most.
example.traditional: 份禮物唔貴，最重要係心意。
example.jyutping: fan6 lai5 mat6 m4 gwai3 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 sam1 ji3
